annotation.authors_or_issuer: Senado Federal do Brasil (Senador Rodrigo Pacheco, author)
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill 2338/2023 sets a legal framework for AI use in Brazil, introduced by Senator Rodrigo Pacheco on 3 May 2023.
Approved by Senate plenary; sent to the Chamber of Deputies for review on 17 March 2025.
Committee (CTIA) rapporteur Eduardo Gomes consolidated multiple AI bills and many amendments into a substitute text.
The page is a tracking portal listing the bill's documents, opinions, 244 amendments and requests.
A public consultation on e-Cidadania drew 35,806 votes in favour and 31,547 against.
annotation.summary_en: Senate legislative tracking page for Brazil's Bill 2338/2023, the AI legal framework authored by Senator Rodrigo Pacheco. It lists the bill's documents, committee reports, amendments and consultation results. The Senate approved the bill and sent it to the Chamber of Deputies in March 2025.
annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n° 2338, de 2023 - Marco Legal da Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 2338 of 2023 - Legal Framework for Artificial Intelligence
